svg.title: Four Core Seats, Two Explicit Expansion Seats
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-seat-core-with-two-seat-expansion; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Two Explicit Expansion Seats; subtitle: Conservative and Base: 1 FT + 3 C (4 people). Scaled: 2 FT + 4 C (6 people).; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate active Conservative and Base core seats: four ones and two zeros. The core comprises 1 FT + 3 C; activate the two zero-valued seats, 1 FT + 1 C, only in the Scaled scenario for 2 FT + 4 C. FT denotes full-time employee seats; C denotes one-person independent service-provider seats, subject to applicable classification tests. Headcount is not a full-time-equivalent measure. External vendor/trade sub-crews are charged to direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through, not internal pod headcount; their delivery capacity and costs must still be measured and funded.; caption: Conservative: $250,000 revenue and $20,000 owner net with four people (1 FT + 3 C). Base: $725,000 revenue and $87,000 owner net with four people (1 FT + 3 C). Scaled: $1,200,000 revenue and $192,000 owner net with six people (2 FT + 4 C). These are separate operating scenarios, not proof that two added seats alone produce the revenue increase. Validate paid hours, external delivery capacity, utilization, pricing, and route capacity before accepting added work.; stages: label: FT 1: pod supervisor and account operations; value: One active employee owning delivery quality, estimates, and billing; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own site mobilization, inspection review, supply readiness, proposal costing, invoice follow-up, and renewals. Coordinate contracted provider outcomes without imposing employee-style methods on independent businesses. Maintain weekly bid-hours versus actual-hours reporting and verify external delivery coverage. If the owner fills this seat, include their work compensation before residual owner net.; label: C 1: floor-care provider; value: One active independent provider delivering bounded floor projects; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Contract for defined floor-care outcomes with an independently operated provider using appropriate equipment and methods. Verify insurance, competence, scheduling interfaces, and classification under the actual working arrangement.; label: C 2: carpet-care provider; value: One active independent provider delivering scheduled extraction projects; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Purchase scoped carpet extraction outcomes with documented drying requirements, access windows, and property protection. Do not disguise an employee cleaner's regular controlled shift as a specialist subcontract.; label: C 3: interior-glass provider; value: One active independent provider delivering scoped glass services; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Define reachable interior-glass surfaces, frequency, and acceptance evidence. Exclude elevated-access work unless the provider has suitable equipment, training, insurance, and an expressly priced scope.; label: FT 2: scaled working lead; value: Zero core seats; activate one employee for Scaled capacity; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add this second full-time employee only against measured recurring paid-hour demand and adequate collection funding. Perform cleaning and support inspection and route coverage. Record supervisory and field time separately; recalculate overtime exposure and supervisor capacity before expanding.; label: C 4: scaled project-cleaning provider; value: Zero core seats; activate one independent provider for Scaled demand; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add a fourth genuine one-person provider for independently priced deep-cleaning projects with bounded deliverables, not employee-style fill-in shifts. External vendor/trade sub-crews remain direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through rather than additional internal pod seats. Verify their capacity, insurance, and lawful working arrangements.

text.title: Four Core Seats, Two Explicit Expansion Seats
text.tspan: Four Core Seats, Two Explicit Expansion Seats

rect.title: label: FT 1: pod supervisor and account operations; value: One active employee owning delivery quality, estimates, and billing; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own site mobilization, inspection review, supply readiness, proposal costing, invoice follow-up, and renewals. Coordinate contracted provider outcomes without imposing employee-style methods on independent businesses. Maintain weekly bid-hours versus actual-hours reporting and verify external delivery coverage. If the owner fills this seat, include their work compensation before residual owner net.

text.title: FT 1: pod supervisor and account operations

Own site mobilization, inspection review, supply readiness, proposal costing, invoice follow-up, and renewals. Coordinate contracted provider outcomes without imposing employee-style methods on independent businesses. Maintain weekly bid-hours versus actual-hours reporting and verify external delivery coverage. If the owner fills this seat, include their work compensation before residual owner net.

rect.title: label: C 1: floor-care provider; value: One active independent provider delivering bounded floor projects; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Contract for defined floor-care outcomes with an independently operated provider using appropriate equipment and methods. Verify insurance, competence, scheduling interfaces, and classification under the actual working arrangement.

text.title: Contract for defined floor-care outcomes with an independently operated provider using appropriate equipment and methods. Verify insurance, competence, scheduling interfaces, and classification under the actual working arrangement.

rect.title: label: C 2: carpet-care provider; value: One active independent provider delivering scheduled extraction projects; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Purchase scoped carpet extraction outcomes with documented drying requirements, access windows, and property protection. Do not disguise an employee cleaner's regular controlled shift as a specialist subcontract.

text.title: Purchase scoped carpet extraction outcomes with documented drying requirements, access windows, and property protection. Do not disguise an employee cleaner's regular controlled shift as a specialist subcontract.

rect.title: label: C 3: interior-glass provider; value: One active independent provider delivering scoped glass services; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Define reachable interior-glass surfaces, frequency, and acceptance evidence. Exclude elevated-access work unless the provider has suitable equipment, training, insurance, and an expressly priced scope.

text.title: Define reachable interior-glass surfaces, frequency, and acceptance evidence. Exclude elevated-access work unless the provider has suitable equipment, training, insurance, and an expressly priced scope.

rect.title: label: FT 2: scaled working lead; value: Zero core seats; activate one employee for Scaled capacity; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add this second full-time employee only against measured recurring paid-hour demand and adequate collection funding. Perform cleaning and support inspection and route coverage. Record supervisory and field time separately; recalculate overtime exposure and supervisor capacity before expanding.

text.title: Add this second full-time employee only against measured recurring paid-hour demand and adequate collection funding. Perform cleaning and support inspection and route coverage. Record supervisory and field time separately; recalculate overtime exposure and supervisor capacity before expanding.

rect.title: label: C 4: scaled project-cleaning provider; value: Zero core seats; activate one independent provider for Scaled demand; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add a fourth genuine one-person provider for independently priced deep-cleaning projects with bounded deliverables, not employee-style fill-in shifts. External vendor/trade sub-crews remain direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through rather than additional internal pod seats. Verify their capacity, insurance, and lawful working arrangements.

text.title: Add a fourth genuine one-person provider for independently priced deep-cleaning projects with bounded deliverables, not employee-style fill-in shifts.
